notes.title: Espirito Delusion v1.3
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is Aura, game developer of ESPIRITO Delusion. We are bringing you a small update with a new system for combat: Global Actions. Global Actions are actions that can be used by anyone in the party during combat, they are simple technically but really effective in combat. Currently, there are 2 global actions that are enabled by default: [/p][list][*][p]Guard - Reduces damage received during the turn and converts damage received into SIN.,[/p][/*][*][p]Pray - Performs a prayer, with a chance of receiving an additional action, increased damage, damage reduction and adding FAITH during the turn.,[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535911/58b79ff68dafed8409a2ebfdecddd18dd99faa7f.png"][/img] 

We also added a new collectable: Coins of FAITH. These coins are scattered across the map and can be collected to earn coins to upgrade your friends.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45535911/a9d2f7ada8a1e9043353c3ba49e2dd6875fdbca3.png"][/img]


 Along with that, we added and fixed some things: [/p][list][*][p]A new enemy: The Rotten One,[/p][/*][*][p]Removed <tags> while the dialogue is being animated,[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled interaction while controlling the Tiger-Shark and after interacting with the bowls.,[/p][/*][*][p]Bug fixes[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: What is coming to ESPIRITO Delusion
notes.content:
[p]Hello, this is Aura, game developer of ESPIRITO Delusion.


 Soon, we will complete a month since we published the game, and I want to thank everyone for the support and feedback since.
 [/p][p]I decided to make the first devlog of ESPIRITO Delusion with the feedback I’ve collected and show a little bit of what I’m working to improve the game: [i]  [/i][/p][previewyoutube="6M2YjJtaGEs;full"][/previewyoutube][p]


TL;DR: [/p][list][*][p]New defensive action called “Guard” that reduces damage, expect more actions soon.,[/p][/*][*][p]New optional challenging enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]New props, items and improved ambience of the existing levels.[/p][/*][/list]
